lockedHeading: Point out details right on the model.
lockedBody: Add numbered hotspots — “Water-resistant zipper”, “Real leather handle” — that shoppers tap to read a note while the camera turns to that spot.
placingHeading: Click the model to place the hotspot
placingBody: Turn the model to the side you want first — the hotspot opens from this same angle for shoppers.
translatingHelp: Translating titles, descriptions and link text into {language}. A field left empty shows the {primary} text. Position, media, products and links are shared by every language.
empty: No hotspots yet. Add one, then click the spot on the model in the preview.
title: Title
linkUrlInvalid: Use an https:// address or a path like /pages/size-guide
openOnDetails: On small container width or touch screens hotspots always open with a tap.
notInAr: Hotspots don’t appear in AR — iPhone and Android AR viewers don’t support them.
productNoVariant: That product has no variant to sell.
videoLink: YouTube, Vimeo or video file link
videoLinkInvalid: Paste a YouTube or Vimeo link, or an https link to an .mp4 file
videoHelp: Shoppers see a thumbnail; the video loads only when they press play.
productHelp: Price and stock are read live from your store when a shopper opens the hotspot.
blocksHelp: Drag a block by its ⠿ handle to change where it shows in the card. The title always stays on top.
languageNotPublishedHelp: Shoppers will see these translations once you add and publish {language} in Settings → Languages.
